column1: # a <TAB> b <TAB> Compare(a, b), parsed with the npm grammar. "\t" and "\n" in a field stand for the characters.

# npm.rs version_comparisons_test (comparisons.js): the first is greater
# not in the Rust tests: the rules written out
# a numeric identifier sorts before an alphanumeric one
# two numeric identifiers that are equal as numbers fall back to a string comparison
# an identifier that does not fit in a u64 is a string
